selection: Explicit disorder/unstructured/IDR/IDP description; exclude mixed folded-domain annotations and unpaired descriptions. Not a disorder prediction or a complete catalog of LLPS IDRs. Separate intervals are separate observations, not necessarily autonomous LLPS constructs.
counting: 1-based inclusive coordinates; no minimum length; retain distinct accessions even if sequences match; pool residues within each bin. 100 and 200 aa are included in the middle bin.
